1.title: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?

candidates.text: Dustin gets back from summer camp and drags the others up a hill to assemble a huge homemade radio tower.
candidates.grounded_in: Dustin Henderson returns from summer camp and, with the help of Lucas Sinclair, Max Mayfield, and Will Byers, sets up a radio tower

candidates.text: Nancy and Jonathan are spending the summer as interns at the local newspaper, where the older men there belittle her.
candidates.grounded_in: Nancy Wheeler and Jonathan Byers work as interns for the Hawkins Post. Nancy experiences sexism from her older male staff.

candidates.text: The shiny new mall has drawn everyone away, shuttering shops downtown, and locals are furious about it.
candidates.grounded_in: the popularity of the new Starcourt Mall has forced many local businesses to close, angering townspeople

candidates.text: Dustin sits alone at his transmitter after his friends wander off, and picks up a broadcast in Russian.
candidates.grounded_in: Dustin's friends leave, and he intercepts a Russian radio transmission.

candidates.text: Dustin finds Steve working behind the counter of the ice cream parlour at the new mall.
candidates.grounded_in: Dustin reunites with Steve Harrington, who works at the mall's ice cream parlor

candidates.text: Eleven and Max spend the day shopping together at Starcourt Mall, trying on clothes to cheer themselves up.
candidates.grounded_in: Eleven and Max bond, going shopping at Starcourt Mall to distract themselves from Mike and Lucas

candidates.text: Nancy and Jonathan visit an elderly woman's house, where she complains about rabid rats eating her fertilizer.
candidates.grounded_in: investigate the home of Mrs. Driscoll, an elderly woman concerned about rabid rats eating her fertilizer

candidates.text: Joyce notices magnets no longer stick at home or at work, and turns up at the science teacher's house.
candidates.grounded_in: Joyce tries to figure out why magnets at her home and workplace have stopped working

3.title: Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard

candidates.text: At a sleepover, Eleven playfully uses her powers to spy on Mike, Lucas, and Will from a distance.
candidates.grounded_in: While having a sleepover with Max, Eleven jokingly uses her powers to spy on Mike, Lucas, and Will.

candidates.text: Will tries to get the boys to sit down for a Dungeons and Dragons campaign like old times.
candidates.grounded_in: After his attempts to play Dungeons and Dragons like old times

candidates.text: Upset with his friends, Will bikes off alone and retreats to Castle Byers in the woods.
candidates.grounded_in: He retreats to Castle Byers

candidates.text: In the back room of the ice cream parlor, Robin works through the Russian message with Steve and Dustin.
candidates.grounded_in: Robin decodes the Russian communication

candidates.text: Eleven and Max drive around town trying to track down Heather, the lifeguard nobody has seen lately.
candidates.grounded_in: She and Max discover that Heather has gone missing.

3.note: Most of this episode's beats are discoveries or confrontations; the safe texture is limited to the sleepover, D&D attempt, and Castle Byers.

4.title: Chapter Four: The Sauna Test

candidates.text: Dustin, Steve and Robin creep around the mall's loading dock, with Lucas's little sister tagging along behind them.
candidates.grounded_in: Dustin, Steve, and Robin, alongside Lucas' sister Erica, discover that the mall's loading dock is an elevator

candidates.text: Will, Eleven, Mike, Lucas and Max huddle together at the deserted town pool after hours, working out a plan.
candidates.grounded_in: They devise a plan to trap Billy in the pool's sauna

candidates.text: Hopper and Joyce turn up in the town mayor's office together and lean on him for answers.
candidates.grounded_in: he and Joyce force Kline to reveal

candidates.text: Dustin, Steve, Robin, and Erica keep out of sight while soldiers unload crates from the elevator underground.
candidates.grounded_in: hide from Russian soldiers unloading crates from the elevator

candidates.text: Hopper and Joyce turn up at Murray's door because he is the only Russian speaker they know.
candidates.grounded_in: Hopper and Joyce take him to Murray–the only Russian speaker they know–to translate

candidates.text: Hopper and Joyce search through one of the town's abandoned properties together.
candidates.grounded_in: Hopper and Joyce search one of the abandoned properties

candidates.text: Nancy and Jonathan rejoin the younger kids, and the whole group heads for the hospital together.
candidates.grounded_in: Nancy and Jonathan regroup with Eleven, Mike, Lucas, Max, and Will

candidates.text: At Murray's place, Hopper and Joyce question their Russian captive with Murray reluctantly translating back and forth.
candidates.grounded_in: With Murray translating, Hopper and Joyce hold Alexei hostage, forcing him to reveal that the Russians are attempting to access the Upside Down

candidates.text: Mayor Kline is cornered by the Russian enforcer amid the crowds and rides of Hawkins' Independence Day fair.
candidates.grounded_in: Grigori corners Kline at Hawkins' Independence Day fair, demanding he step up efforts to find Hopper

candidates.text: Joyce insists they drive straight back to Hawkins, afraid their kids are already caught up in this.
candidates.grounded_in: Joyce insists they return to Hawkins immediately, fearing that their kids may be involved

candidates.text: Hopper gets on a phone to Owens, trying to pass a warning up to the American government.
candidates.grounded_in: Hopper calls Owens to warn the U.S. Government of the threat

candidates.text: Dustin and Erica park a woozy Steve and Robin in the seats of the mall's movie theater.
candidates.grounded_in: Dustin and Erica hide a drugged Steve and Robin in the Starcourt movie theater

candidates.text: The kids break into a closed supermarket after hours, raiding the aisles for supplies.
candidates.grounded_in: Eleven's group breaks into a supermarket to help treat her wounds and gather more supplies

candidates.text: Dustin tries to explain everything over the walkie-talkie, but his batteries die mid-conversation.
candidates.grounded_in: Dustin contacts them over a walkie-talkie to try to explain the situation before he loses battery power

candidates.text: Hopper, Joyce and Murray push through the crowds at the Hawkins Fourth of July fairgrounds hunting for the kids.
candidates.grounded_in: Hopper's group make their way to the fairgrounds in Hawkins to find the children

8.title: Chapter Eight: The Battle of Starcourt

candidates.text: Dustin and Erica perch at the hilltop radio tower, relaying directions over the airwaves to the adults far below.
candidates.grounded_in: with Dustin and Erica navigating them from his radio tower

candidates.text: The kids haul out their stockpile of fireworks and set them off one after another inside the darkened mall.
candidates.grounded_in: The others attack the Mind Flayer with fireworks

candidates.text: The adults' car finally catches up with the kids at the mall, and plans are made to get everyone somewhere safe.
candidates.grounded_in: Hopper's group arrives, and plans are made to take Eleven's group to safety.

8.note: Nearly every distinctive moment in this finale is a death, sacrifice, arrest, or the closing of the gate, so usable texture is thin.
